scenario.title: 當導師、分享經驗
scenario.context: 當你開始帶新人，就換你給建議了：「你要負責這個」「這取決於客戶」「他很擅長這個」。這些說法都靠「形容詞／動詞 + 固定介系詞」：good at、responsible for、depend on、interested in。介系詞用錯是台灣人英文最常見的小錯誤。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: So Kai, this week you'll be responsible for the social media graphics.

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.en: Got it. How many posts per week?

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It depends on the client. Some want three, some want daily.
lines.zh: 要看客戶，有些要三篇，有些要每天。

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.en: I'm really interested in learning about branding, too.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Great. A good rule of thumb: always read the brand guide before you start anything.
lines.zh: 很好。一個經驗法則是：開始做任何東西前，一定先讀品牌規範。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Don't be afraid of asking questions. I learned that the hard way.
lines.zh: 別怕問問題。那是我吃過虧才學到的。

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.en: The client said my design was "too busy." I'm not sure what to do.
lines.zh: 客戶說我的設計「太雜」，我不知道該怎麼辦。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Clients aren't always good at explaining what they want. Take it with a grain of salt, but look for the real problem.
lines.zh: 客戶不一定很會說明他們要什麼。聽聽就好，但要找出真正的問題。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Could be. Try reducing it to two colors and see how it feels. A lot of design is trial and error.
lines.zh: 有可能。試著減到兩個顏色看看感覺。很多設計都是靠嘗試錯誤。

lines.speaker: Kai
lines.en: Thanks. I was worried about disappointing you.
lines.zh: 謝謝。我很擔心讓你失望。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: You're not. I'm proud of how fast you're learning.
lines.zh: 你沒有。我很驕傲你學得這麼快。

patterns.en: A good rule of thumb is ___.
I learned that the hard way.
What are you most interested in?
Feel free to ask me anything.
patterns.zh: 有任何問題都可以問我。

patterns.en: Let's check in at the end of the week.

chinglish.why: depend 後面要加 on，這是固定搭配。

chinglish.wrong: I'm responsible to the social media.
chinglish.why: 負責某事用 responsible for；responsible to 是「向某人負責」。

chinglish.right: Don't be afraid to ask. / Don't be afraid of asking.
chinglish.why: afraid 是形容詞，前面要有 be。

grammar.title: 介系詞搭配 good at / responsible for / depend on
grammar.oneLiner: 很多形容詞和動詞後面有固定搭配的介系詞，沒有邏輯可推，要整組記。
whenToUse: 形容詞 + at：good at, bad at, surprised at。
形容詞 + for：responsible for, famous for, ready for, grateful for。
形容詞 + of：afraid of, proud of, tired of, aware of, capable of。
形容詞 + in / with / about：interested in, familiar with, worried about, excited about。
動詞 + on：depend on, rely on, focus on, insist on。
動詞 + for / about / to：apply for, apologize for, complain about, listen to, belong to。
介系詞後面的動詞用 V-ing：good at drawing / afraid of asking（第 14、86 單元）。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「擅長」「負責」「依賴」「有興趣」都不需要介系詞，或者都用「對」。英文每個字都有自己固定的搭配，而且看不出規則：為什麼是 good at 而不是 good in？為什麼是 interested in 而不是 interested on？這類錯誤雖然不影響溝通，卻是母語者一聽就知道你英文程度的地方。

examples.correct: She's really good at explaining things.
examples.incorrect: She's really good in explaining things.

quiz.question: I'm so proud ___ what you've achieved.

slang.usage: 透過痛苦的經驗學到教訓。

examples.en: Always back up your files. I learned that the hard way.
examples.zh: 檔案一定要備份，我是吃過虧才學到的。

examples.en: Some lessons you can only learn the hard way.
examples.zh: 有些教訓只能靠吃苦頭學到。

slang.usage: 根據經驗得出的實用原則，不一定精確但很好用。

examples.en: As a rule of thumb, don't use more than three fonts.
examples.zh: 一般原則是，別用超過三種字體。

examples.en: My rule of thumb is to reply to emails within 24 hours.
examples.zh: 我的原則是 24 小時內回信。

slang.term: take it with a grain of salt
slang.usage: 對某個說法保持懷疑，不全盤接受。英式說 take it with a pinch of salt。

examples.en: Online reviews are useful, but take them with a grain of salt.
examples.zh: 網路評論有用，但聽聽就好。

examples.en: He exaggerates a lot, so take his stories with a grain of salt.
examples.zh: 他很愛誇大，他的故事聽聽就好。

slang.usage: 透過不斷嘗試和修正來找到答案。

examples.en: I learned to cook through trial and error.
examples.zh: 我靠不斷嘗試學會煮飯。

examples.en: Finding the right color palette takes a lot of trial and error.
examples.zh: 找到對的配色需要很多嘗試。

review.question: If I had had a mentor, I ___ so many mistakes back then.
review.explanation: 複習第 88 單元：過去→過去用 type 3。

review.question: That's the reason ___ I became a designer.
review.explanation: 複習第 87 單元：the reason why。

review.question: (Formal) Please do not hesitate to ___ us.
review.explanation: 複習第 85 單元：正式語域。

review.question: Rarely ___ a new hire learn so fast.
You ___ try asking the senior designer.
review.explanation: 複習第 73 單元：could 提供選項。

review.question: Kai, ___ joined last month, is already leading a project.
review.explanation: 複習第 57 單元：非限定子句。

review.question: Let me call ___ after lunch.
review.explanation: 複習第 25 單元：代名詞放中間。
